availableCommands.name: accli
availableCommands.description: This skill should be used when interacting with Apple Calendar on macOS. Use it for listing calendars, viewing events, creating/updating/deleting calendar events, and checking availability/free-busy times. Triggers on requests like "check my calendar", "schedule a meeting", "what's on my schedule", "am I free tomorrow", or any calendar-related operations.

availableCommands.name: customize-opencode
availableCommands.description: Use ONLY when the user is editing or creating opencode's own configuration: opencode.json, opencode.jsonc, files under .opencode/, or files under ~/.config/opencode/. Also use when creating or fixing opencode agents, subagents, skills, plugins, MCP servers, or permission rules. Do not use for the user's own application code, or for any project that is not configuring opencode itself.

availableCommands.name: domain-modeling
availableCommands.description: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when discussing codebase terminology, writing or editing a CONTEXT.md, or recording or editing an ADR.

availableCommands.name: find-skills
availableCommands.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

availableCommands.name: gpt-researcher
availableCommands.description: Run the GPT Researcher autonomous agent to generate comprehensive deep research reports. Requires LLM and Search API keys (e.g., OPENAI_API_KEY, TAVILY_API_KEY).

availableCommands.name: grill-with-docs
availableCommands.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

availableCommands.name: grilling
availableCommands.description: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.

availableCommands.name: jw-publication-retriever
availableCommands.description: tools for semantic and keyword search against a vector database of jw(Jehovah's Witnesses) publications.

availableCommands.name: obsidian
availableCommands.description: Work with Obsidian vaults (plain Markdown notes) and automate via obsidian-cli.

availableCommands.name: ocr-health
availableCommands.description: Check OpenCodeReview and its LLM connection

availableCommands.name: open-code-review
availableCommands.description: Performs AI-powered code review on Git changes using the `ocr` CLI from alibaba/open-code-review. Use when the user asks to review code, review a pull request, review staged/unstaged changes, review a commit, or compare branches for code quality issues. Produces line-level review comments and can automatically apply fixes when requested. With appropriate review rules, can detect various types of issues including bugs, security vulnerabilities, performance problems, and code quality concerns.

availableCommands.name: playwright-cli
availableCommands.description: Automate browser interactions, test web pages and work with Playwright tests.
